title: CORE-06 Workflow Pack Contract, Starter SDK, and Automatic Task Intake
purpose: Deliver a self-contained Workflow Pack contract and Starter SDK so workflows install without editing Local Brain core, plus Automatic Task Intake & Track Selection across built-in and pack workflows.

excluded: Automatic model swapping / Model Garage auto-switching
Remote marketplace download or unverified code execution

acceptanceCriteria.description: Workflow Pack manifest schema (locaily.workflow_pack.v1) and path-safe loader dynamically register tracks, tools, prompts, schemas, workflows, permissions, and qualification requirements with zero edits to Local Brain core.

evidence.note: AC1-AC5 verified schema validation, path traversal escape blocking, ID conflict rejection, dynamic registration across all registries, and permission/qualification readiness.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Reference pack (workflow-packs/incident-triage-pack/) executes end-to-end composing pack-local tracks/tools/schemas/prompts with shared core.* capabilities, and Starter SDK CLI (pack:list, pack:init, pack:validate, pack:test) scaffolds, validates, and runs a fresh pack in isolation.

evidence.note: pack:validate and pack:test passed on workflow-packs/incident-triage-pack (1/1 fixture, schemaValid: true); AC6 passed pack:init -> pack:validate -> pack:test in isolated temp dir.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Automatic Task Intake implements deterministic intent hints -> optional qualification-gated small classifier -> candidate workflow/track selection -> contract & capability check -> selected / confirm_required / refused with uncertainty, explanations, and strict anti-invention enforcement.

evidence.note: AC1-AC4 verified deterministic routing, ambiguity confirm_required, unsupported refusal, qualification gating, and invented workflow ID rejection.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Human-labeled dataset (>= 20 cases covering built-in workflows, installed Workflow Pack, ambiguous prompts, and unsupported refusals) achieves >= 90% accuracy, 100% unsupported refusal rate, and 0% invented tracks.

evidence.note: 26/26 passed (100.0% accuracy, 100.0% refusal recall, 0 invented tracks) via evaluateLabeledDataset.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Additive HTTP endpoints (GET /packs, GET /packs/:id, POST /packs/validate, POST /intake/route, POST /workflows/intake) and Companion Console (companion/console/) + Unified Shell (companion/shell/) UI surfaces work end-to-end.

evidence.note: AC6 tested live HTTP routes on companion/server.js (including incident_triage execution via /intake/route) and verified Console + Shell UI markup/scripts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: npm run test:workflow-packs, npm run test:task-intake, and full npm run test:full pass 100% green.

evidence.note: npm run test:workflow-packs (6/6), npm run test:task-intake (6/6), and npm run test:full (all 26 suites) passed with exit code 0.
